title: OAuth Success on web page but Error in Terminal: OAuth error: Unable to create API key.
body:
Browser didn't open? Use the url below to sign in:

https://console.anthropic.com/oauth/authorize?client_id=9d1c250a-e61b-44d9-88ed-5944d1962f5e&response_type=code&redirect_uri=%2Foauth%2Fcode%2Fcallback&scope=org%3Acreate_api_key+user%3Aprofile&code_challenge=ANiqwjfvCsOdTQn0cIskDiPiO865vUPWW2sKQAaMWIQ&code_challenge_method=S256&state=AHCEIU9-YEyKqhFiyEPEyB7hKXVXBgrOchFkWDDP7uI
